items.caption: A modern rendering of 問 in Shuowen seal-script style. In the received analysis, 口 is the meaning element and 門 the sound element; the available sound comparisons do not independently establish that historical correspondence.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 問: tall outer strokes enclose a large central opening, with two smaller openings above it.
items.selection_reason: This legible rendering illustrates the received form and analysis of 問. It does not establish a lineage from the disputed Shang graphs.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an excavated artifact. The identity and relationship to 問 of Shang graphs combining 門 and 口 remain disputed; a proposed identification as expanded forms of 啟 is tentative.
